plan.primary_unit: Scenario instance, not execution or repeated audio
plan.required_before_start: Materialize/hash all 500 external scripts/fixtures and arm applicability; freeze campaign manifest

primary_endpoints.correction_success: Domain-permitted external final intent with no forbidden effect; revision cases only
primary_endpoints.unsupported_confirmation: At least one decisive client exposure lacking applicable evidence at release/play; post-commit ambiguity cases only

clean_noninferiority.bound: Bonferroni exact binomial bounds on paired wins and losses, .025 per tail
clean_noninferiority.utility_guard: Safety improvement requires passing clean NI and reporting outcome coverage
clean_noninferiority.margin_origin: Phase 7 design choice, not an implementation-pack constant

budgets.failure_policy: Record infrastructure failure/timeout, trace ID and rerun reason; never silently replace

exclusions.task_failures: Retain refusals, UNKNOWN, handoffs, wrong intent, clarification and recognition failures
exclusions.infrastructure: Separate missing/corrupted trace or unavailable infrastructure; retain planned slot and every attempt
exclusions.reruns: Same scenario ID/version, explicit reason, original retained; no replacement chosen for favorable outcome
exclusions.confirmatory_missing: No confirmatory conclusion if planned primary pairs are unaccounted for; report sensitivity bounds
exclusions.structural: Multi-workflow/unavailable side completion infeasible; conflict B0-B2 not applicable, declared before runs

analysis_plan.binary: Exact paired McNemar; raw 2x2 counts; exact binomial rare-event intervals
analysis_plan.latency: Scenario-cluster bootstrap of paired differences, 2000 draws, seed 7001; report NOT_OBSERVED/NOT_COMPARABLE
analysis_plan.timeout: Resolution right-censored at actual recorded timeout; report status/time and survival analysis in Phase 8
analysis_plan.repetitions: If repeated seeds/audio: logistic mixed effects arm/phase/fault/revision/action; scenario-template and audio/speaker random intercepts
analysis_plan.secondary: P1 mechanisms and B0-B2 exploratory comparisons; Holm correction within declared families
analysis_plan.physical_hearing: Not inferred; optional RQ9 study is excluded
analysis_plan.pilot: Descriptive protocol debug only; no confirmatory power, effect, or NI claim

required_before_execution: 500 externally specified scenario fixtures and hashes
frozen arm applicability for each slot
container and model/audio versions match freeze
